principle: This tracker recognizes shapes it has seen, not meaning it has not. A new state or document type is unfamiliar until a person decides what the numbers are. A matching type name is not enough: the column set must match a recorded signature exactly.
interpretations: Pennsylvania county lots are geography (the lot the salt is for), not buyers. Named COSTARS members are extra roster rows and are excluded from statewide totals.
Michigan snapYYYY-MM filenames are Wayback listing timestamps, not seasons. Fiscal year comes from printed schedule titles.

Pennsylvania FY2024 tons are the COSTARS packet Cumulative Estimate column (tons_basis=printed). FY2026 and FY2027 tons are the eMarketplace estimates attachment (tons_basis=committed_estimate). Those are different document types.

The FY2027 estimates attachment is a 9-column layout (COSTARS as a single Total Quantity). FY2026 split COSTARS into Initial Fill / Balance / Total. Same document_type, different columns — that is not routine.
Michigan 260000000712 / 260000000713 are not automatically the same series as 180000000768 / 180000000787. Renumbering is reported, never auto-linked.
